knowHow.text: PA612-ESD is an ESD-safe nylon material engineered to offer outstanding thermal and mechanical properties, making it ideal for sensitive electronic applications.
Fiberon™ PA612-ESD is sensitive to moisture and should always be stored and used under dry conditions (relative humidity below 20%).
Normally, the life of a brass nozzle would be approximately 9h.
Abrasion of the brass nozzle happens frequently when printing Fiberon™ PA612-ESD.
A wear-resistance nozzle, such as hardened steel and ruby nozzle, is highly recommended to be used with Fiberon™ PA612-ESD.
Otherwise, the support structure can be permanently bonded to the model.
If Fiberon™ PA612-ESD is used as the support material for itself, please remove the support structure before excessive moisture absorption.

polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. DuPont's Zytel guide (R-DUPONT-ZYTEL-GUIDE) prints, for the unreinforced PA612 grades Zytel 151L and 153HSL, a density of 1060 kg/m³ (ISO 1183), a melting temperature of 218 °C (ISO 11357-1/-3) and a water absorption, similar to ISO 62, of 1.3 % at equilibrium at 50 % RH and 23 °C and 3 % saturated, immersed at 23 °C, p. 8.
